Verdict convention used: 'fix' only where every fix was applied by the reviewer (janapada-of-matsya). Advisory overlaps that are not blocking are listed under thin or cross_checks, not under fixes.

Rule 2 (one dossier per state, a dynasty change is a rename): janapada-of-magadha, magadha-haryanka-dynasty, magadha-shaishunaga-dynasty and arguably nanda-empire are one state, Magadha, under successive dynasties. janapada-of-magadha already has a rename at -544, so the colour change at -500 contradicts the standard. The orchestrator should decide whether to merge them or keep Cliopatria's split, and if it is kept, where the Magadha/Haryanka boundary falls (-544 on the page, -500 in Cliopatria).

Neighbour dossiers janapada-of-cedi (Banda, Rewa) and janapada-of-avanti (Maheshwar) use places the gazetteer cannot resolve, so their shapes do not compute; the overlap checks against them were done with Cliopatria discs instead.
